title: RNA Extraction with Trizol
author: Dakota Betz
materials: 7) Transfer column to labeled RNase free tube.

steps.title: Prepare Tissue and Trizol
steps.instruction: Prepare the tissue samples and Trizol in bead bashing tubes while maintaining cold temperatures.

substeps.instruction: Add 770 uL of Trizol to one bead bashing tube per sample.
Pour tissue into a clean Petri dish and keep on a cooling block (flat ice pack).
Transfer pieces of tissue to the bead bashing tube, blotting RNAlater with a kim tissue until really dry (especially for small amounts of tissue). Perform this on an ice pack.

steps.title: Homogenize Tissue
steps.instruction: Beadbash the samples until the tissue is dissolved.

substeps.instruction: Beadbash 3-4 times for 15 seconds at max speed.
Cool down for 5-10 seconds between cycles by placing the tube in/on an ice block.
Stop immediately once tissue is dissolved.

steps.title: Clarify Lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the homogenate to separate the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Transfer liquid to a 1.6 mL RNase free tube.
Centrifuge at 12000 x g for 2 minutes (use a block from the lab freezer to keep tubes cold).
Transfer the supernatant to a new 1.6 mL RNase free tube.

steps.title: Prepare for Column Loading
steps.instruction: Add ethanol to the supernatant to prepare for RNA binding.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 uL of 100% ethanol to each tube.
Vortex the mixture.

steps.title: Load RNA onto ZymoSpin Column
steps.instruction: Bind the RNA to the ZymoSpin IIC Column.

substeps.instruction: Load 700 uL into a ZymoSpin IIC Column placed in a 2mL-size RNase-free collection tube.
Centrifuge at 12000 x g for 1 minute.
If using sea cucumbers, urchins, or other tissues prone to clogging, split the sample into two ZymoSpin IIC Columns and treat as separate samples until the final step.

steps.title: Initial Column Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the column and remove flow-through.

substeps.instruction: Discard flow-through.
Repeat the loading/centrifugation with the remaining 700 uL (if applicable).
If the first half did not flow through completely, centrifuge at 12000 x g for 2 minutes.

steps.title: In-Column DNase Digestion
steps.instruction: Perform on-column digestion to remove DNA.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the column to an RNase-free tube.
Wash with 400 uL of RNA Wash Buffer and centrifuge at 12000 x g for 30 seconds; discard flow-through.
Add 80 uL of DNase I Reaction Mix (composed of 75 µL DNA digestion Buffer and 5 µL DNase I from the green cap freezer stock) directly to the column.
Incubate for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 12000 x g for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Column Pre-Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the column with Direct-zol RNA PreWash.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 uL of Direct-zol RNA PreWash and centrifuge at 12000 x g for 1 minute.
Discard flow-through and repeat the PreWash and centrifugation step.

steps.title: Final Column Wash
steps.instruction: Perform final washes to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 uL of RNA Wash Buffer and centrifuge at 12000 x g for 1 minute.
Discard flow-through.
Centrifuge again in an emptied collection tube at 12000 x g for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the purified RNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Add 26 uL of RNase-free water to the column.
Incubate for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 12000 x g for 1 minute.

steps.title: Quality Control
steps.instruction: Combine eluates if necessary and perform QC.

substeps.instruction: Combine tubes if the sample was split across two columns.
Take 5 uL for QC/Qubit using the 'Qubit RNA HS' kit.
